0022600118.text: The 2-0 Grizzlies, who are 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, visit the 0-2 Sacramento Kings, who are 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 14th in the West. Memphis is without Cedric Coward (wrist sprain), who is averaging 7.0 points and 27.8 minutes per game this season, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the Grizzlies lost 123-114 in Memphis in their last meeting on February 23, 2026.
